workflowElements.name: KOS: Write Curator Output
workflowElements.description: Merges the optional Auditor sign-off into the Curator's JSON output (if Step 2a is wired in), overwrites the source document body with the result, and marks the STAGING_PIPELINE row FLOW_COMPLETE — but only on success. On any failure, writes nothing and leaves Status untouched so the staleness guard retries. Use as the last step of the Curator Flow (SESSION_LOG / EXTERNAL_DATA / COG_STIMULUS), after the native Ask Gemini step(s).

inputs.description: BRAIN_TRUST_INDEX spreadsheet ID (from the INDEX_ID script property).
Payload_UID of the trigger row (STAGING_PIPELINE column 1).
File_ID of the trigger row (STAGING_PIPELINE column 4) — the doc this step overwrites.
Raw JSON text from the native Ask Gemini step running CURATOR_PROMPT.md.
Raw JSON text from the optional native Ask Gemini Auditor step. Leave unmapped (or map to an empty string) if this flow doesn't run an Auditor pass.

outputs.description: SUCCESS, CURATOR_JSON_PARSE_FAILED, AUDITOR_JSON_PARSE_FAILED, DOC_WRITE_FAILED, or STAGING_ROW_NOT_FOUND_AFTER_DOC_WRITE.

workflowElements.name: KOS: Write Classification Output
workflowElements.description: Validates the Classifier's JSON array output, overwrites the source document body with it, and marks the STAGING_PIPELINE row FLOW_COMPLETE — but only on success. On any failure, writes nothing and leaves Status untouched so the staleness guard retries. Use as the last step of the VECTOR_CLASSIFY Flow, after the native Ask Gemini step.

inputs.description: BRAIN_TRUST_INDEX spreadsheet ID (from the INDEX_ID script property).
Payload_UID of the trigger row (STAGING_PIPELINE column 1).
File_ID of the trigger row (STAGING_PIPELINE column 4) — the doc this step overwrites.
Raw JSON array text from the native Ask Gemini step running VECTOR_CLASSIFY_PROMPT.md.

outputs.description: SUCCESS, CLASSIFICATION_JSON_PARSE_FAILED, CLASSIFICATION_JSON_NOT_ARRAY, DOC_WRITE_FAILED, or STAGING_ROW_NOT_FOUND_AFTER_DOC_WRITE.
